# Reconciled acceptance and original custody follow-ups

## Source and publication boundary

This continuation publishes after the independent documentation commit
`c6ca02296ab46713b3f79dadfb44b5af3577f1c6`, whose only change is
[plan 28](28-exact-head-acceptance-followups-2026-11-15.md). Its executable
preimages are unchanged from merge `61e62d6965cab8d8e6ce6975b34ce80723df6b85`
on Draft PR [#1192](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/pull/1192).
Its parents are our acceptance correction
`b3f29d45425dd19cd2dc08c366f27e3d1fbb523d` and the independently prepared
current-frontend integration `b978fce66e54c2fbe3af0cef0d61b79c7f2c5916`.
Preserve both histories and the current frontend snapshot described in
[plan 26](26-current-frontend-reconciliation-2026-11-15.md).

The base remains #1186, `def734338f13bcc3209e78079a0cedbc48f05a5b`.
The checked provider source remains
`421fee918811b8a0b0c73d0ff3e761b9a1c5ecb0`; the pinned archive SHA-256 is
`91350f829b72f83e613505bb444ff0d9ef98fb0835e3e438b918bbea8d930f94`.

The branch is Draft. No main merge, release, default activation or Stage 2
advancement is part of this cut. Real Claude Code and Codex are forbidden,
including version invocations and native binaries pointed at localhost.
Finite protocol peers and the original Host/Main/Electron TEST composition
remain the required substitutes. OpenCode local/native checks retain their
existing allowed scope.

## Reconciliation and residual changes

The merge already contains the original OpenCode prospective destination fix,
Runtime-derived saved-import probes, the shared pinned finite auth-status peer,
the private cold-PATH installer alias and the reserved late native read-failure
observation. These changes were read from the exact merge source and preserved;
the pending parallel proposals were not copied over them.

| Existing owner | Residual correction and retained proof |
| --- | --- |
| Saved-import TEST wrapper | Extract the current wrapper generator so the existing unit exercises the same role checks, exact helper hashes and shared auth dispatch as Desktop. The generated wrapper body is unchanged. |
| Saved-import finite peer | Bind metadata to management and a named saved-model probe to Runtime in both directions. A management-role model probe is refused before protocol input; Runtime auth and metadata remain refused. |
| Import evidence | Check the original `team-probe-` digest namespace, configuration revision, provider and model context. Join every child event to one original birth, require one Runtime input/terminal per probe and preserve the exact session, input, model, effort and terminal checks. The existing auth child has exactly its actual two events and command; no synthetic direct command-ID/PID join is claimed. |
| Import workflow | Permit Runtime effects only for saved import, then run the stronger original import observer. Other management scenarios, Host-parent proof, executable pins, every-child cleanup, empty runtime-session inventory and no extra business captures remain required. |
| Codex installer fixture | Before replacing the generated private sentinel, verify its original digest and canonical parent. After Update, require the exact private alias, symlink target, canonical source A and A digest; retain that proof in the original receipt. No environment override or changed managed-B precedence. |
| Original resolver/path tests | Exercise cold invalid-sentinel refusal, canonical A alias selection and managed B through the existing resolver. A separate existing path-merge test proves the actual private-vendor-before-PATH ordering. Only the native version port is mocked; no vendor binary is run. |
| Main OpenCode regression | Strengthen the existing destination cases with original member identity, saved-model and diagnostic controls, exact returned selections, cold same-ID reconstruction and unchanged view. Existing Claude/Codex controls remain. The Host regression additionally asserts the original product roster revision already captured for the exact prospective destination. No Main/Host authority condition is changed. |
| Original CDP observation | Classify the already-read exact helper basenames `node-exec` and `linux-child-exec` in the closed diagnostic vocabulary. Preserve the strict one-holder oracle and original read/birth guards; classification is not attestation. |
| Original Windows cleanup | Before the existing assertion, expose only the retained slot/source reference and closed preparation/cleanup booleans. Preserve the original root/witness wait, Job cleanup and missing-handle failure. |
| Teams creation E2E | Use explicit finite native metadata peers for Codex and Claude plus a private initial Codex manifest/config directory. This fences both binary resolution and installer status, whose PATH search ignores the native override. Each generated peer accepts only its finite version and refuses business/auth commands. Existing orchestrator fixture, UI assertions, HOME/PATH and staged runtime remain unchanged. |
| Original Windows controller | Save the existing pipeline's numeric exit code immediately and print a fixed provider-labelled diagnostic before the same failure. No C++ actor, deadline or native operation changes. |

The passive emitter/receiver in the merge already reserves the first valid late
read-cut failure. It trades one ordinary row for that reservation and keeps
the original 257-row, 64-KiB and 513-byte limits, including across Host epochs.
The existing regression already covers invalid and duplicate late cuts,
saturation and privacy. No duplicate edit is needed.

## Completed evidence on b3f29d4

[Host process run 43660190804](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs/43660190804)
has two completed Windows failures. Its Linux and both Darwin jobs were
cancelled before execution by the independent merge publication; they are not
new platform passes.

- Windows x64 job
  [132647647202](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs/43660190804/job/132647647202):
  original source A readiness completed in 7.805 seconds and B in 7.541 seconds.
  The original B standalone receipt reached `completed`, `cleanup=confirmed`,
  `exitCode=0` in 8.352 seconds. The first retained cleanup returned and the
  scenario reached its original cold-read/replay stage. The controller then
  returned failure without its final structured cleanup record. The whole job
  is FAIL; a successful standalone constituent does not prove controller cleanup.
  The old log did not retain the numeric controller exit code, so neither a
  specific C++ return branch nor a native crash is established.
- Windows ARM64 job
  [132647647366](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs/43660190804/job/132647647366):
  source A did not become ready inside the original 15-second observation budget
  (last observed elapsed 15.552 seconds, 104 reads, allocated/unsealed/owned,
  attached, native-ready false). All six recorded original preparations,
  slots 0 through 5, completed with both root and witness. The later cleanup
  assertion lacked a root or witness. This does not identify a failed native
  prepare or establish cleanup. Existing catalog/current-authority checks and
  deadlines are retained.

The Windows source trace and exact Host/pinned-provider source show that
startup performs multiple independent original catalog checks. The six recorded
preparations do not attribute the remaining readiness time to one removable
check. No mandatory check was removed for performance.

[OpenCode V2 run 43660190686](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs/43660190686):

| Original job | Completed result |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 embedded Host, 132647733187 | PASS |
| Windows static source, 132647733233 | PASS |
| Darwin x64 embedded Host, 132647733299 | FAIL at the unchanged POSIX selected-image gate; the earlier native business step passed |
| Windows ARM64, Linux x64, Darwin ARM64, Ubuntu static, native SPI and durable-HTTP discovery | CANCELLED; no completed qualification |

The Darwin failure is the original `registered-process-executable.native.ts`
baseline assertion, observed as 13 versus 0. Its native business result cannot
qualify the failed image oracle.

The original [Desktop/safe run 43660190846](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs/43660190846)
was superseded while all 18 Desktop lanes and all four safe shards were queued.
There is no b3 Desktop or full-safe PASS. Its packaged and general checks were
also superseded before completing their gates.

### Artifact metadata and limits

These are upload-reported ZIP digests, not independent artifact-byte verification:

| Source-bound artifact | ID | Reported SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| b3 Windows x64 process failure | 14140391819 | `f34a4df7787959fdf3ebb7124a9460ce4134ad44502ca4b73f32e165e12e24e0` |
| b3 Windows ARM64 process failure | 14139534797 | `bf026ad4be6c87dbeabdee7b6c72536289b2b98c166763f2ffa25ae6e40780d3` |
| b3 Windows x64 native V2 success | 14140042103 | `fe2620ff15cc1f735d6f5e3681cbd5e130c493896cd04eb9b3c4f78c1f477a6f` |
| b3 Darwin x64 native V2 failure | 14139807952 | `4de4af51cada12f375a5259e8a32b1db2078a3a91786469182f5743631f6fafa` |

The executor remains disconnected. No post-outage local compiler, lint, test,
artifact extraction or screenshot inspection is claimed by this continuation.
The independently reported local integration checks in plan 26 remain attributed
to that work and its stated source; they do not become this residual cut's PASS.

The complete four-shard safe result on
`32c2af517766f86116b4b6441e686e493ad1c9c8` remains the historical result in
[plan 27](27-safe-suite-and-acceptance-followups-2026-11-15.md):
25,517 tests passed, 38 skipped, zero failed; 2,140 files passed and 7 skipped.
Do not add overlapping local groups to those totals or relabel them for newer
bytes.

## New observed failures on the preserved merge

These completed observations belong to `61e62d6` and remain separate from b3:

- Process jobs Darwin x64 `132653521733` and Darwin ARM64 `132653521821`
  completed successfully in run 43662122952. The Linux tuple was still queued.
- Windows x64 `132653521685` reached B standalone completion in 12.158 seconds
  with its own cleanup confirmed and exit zero. It then failed the original
  `jobEntry` exactly-one assertion: two historical journal rows matched the
  numeric root PID/parent PID. The current join reads the entire accumulated
  journal. Reuse of a numeric identity is a plausible cause, not an observed
  native fact without the original artifact. A lifetime-bound journal correction
  needs separate review; the duplicate assertion is not removed.
- Windows ARM64 `132653521505` retained its original A readiness failure
  (98 reads, 15.051 seconds). Slots 0–5 completed; slot 6's original preparation
  finally reported the owner phase with neither recorded root nor witness.
  Cleanup still failed. This narrows the missing observation but does not
  qualify cleanup or authorize removing a readiness check.
- Native V2 Darwin x64 `132653618863` completed its original custody/business
  prerequisites and failed only the unchanged POSIX image gate, again 13 versus 0.
- Installer UI `132653522525` failed waiting for the original Launch Team button
  to become enabled. It had not reached the installer status/Update step.
  Therefore this result neither repeats the older first-status failure nor
  proves the cold-PATH alias correction end to end.

The upload-reported merge artifact metadata is: Windows x64 process
`14140512614` / `e8ed8f32b0d5798683bc81d20a2e0644d7167387d092050ab38ab419371e603e`;
Windows ARM64 process `14141260879` /
`edc25833240f671f1122168920329f4b71b345f4f64ca248c63517d36d3a24cb`;
Darwin x64 native V2 `14140598397` /
`c5538e92d8758de793db74981834434fa703ec2c6060a2f388e69b8840b7d48f`;
and installer UI `14140962833` /
`2545636523ba5075870e3dd44903bc03150562b25f11504f935c3a48cef53dab`.
No independent ZIP, member or screenshot verification is claimed.

## Teams creation workflow environment

The preserved upstream Teams creation workflow runs on Draft PRs. Its original
orchestrator override does not govern native Codex discovery: manual provider
refresh reaches `CodexBinaryResolver`, and installer status independently checks
its managed manifest before searching ambient PATH. Either route could invoke a
runner-installed Codex version command. This is a source-confirmed reachable path;
there is no evidence here that a real vendor binary was installed or executed.

The residual fixture explicitly selects generated finite metadata peers for both
native providers and seeds only its disposable user-data Codex manifest so the
installer status never needs that ambient search. Direct positive/refusal checks
execute only each newly generated finite script through the current Node. The
managed seed is initial TEST state, not an installation result or a Host receipt.
Provider metadata effects have their own fixture ledger; the original orchestrator
lifecycle ledger and all original UI assertions remain intact. No application
HOME/PATH or terminal-runtime bootstrap selection is changed.

A direct workflow cancellation operation was unavailable in the GitHub connector.
The browser fallback also reported no originating connected browser context.
Publication uses the workflow's existing same-PR concurrency cancellation; no
unsupported API mutation or permission workaround is used.

## Required acceptance and remaining uncertainty

Independent source review accepted the residual import, installer, Main/Host
regression and bounded diagnostic changes. The canonical full workspace types,
typed lint, focused behavior checks, all four complete safe shards, original
18 Desktop lanes and relevant packaged/native/process gates must run on the
published residual source. Queued, skipped, cancelled and incomplete jobs are
never PASS.

The merge's existing runs are
[Desktop/safe 43662122805](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs/43662122805),
[process 43662122952](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs/43662122952)
and [V2 43662122971](https://github.com/777genius/agent-teams-ai/actions/runs/43662122971).
Their original source is 61e62d6, not a later residual commit. Inspect actual
completed receipts before assigning an outcome or diagnosing a new failure.

Linux credentials cleanup, the original extra CDP holders, Windows ARM
readiness and Windows x64 controller termination remain open until their own
evidence resolves them. Bounded diagnostics alone do not close these defects.
The selected-source writer and script-consumption contract in P09 §75 remains
unqualified. No writer-policy change, native oracle relaxation, copied/FD-alias
execution, script refusal or signing restriction is introduced here.

## Original ModelProbe cancellation and admitted HTTP

A separate source review found a concrete cancellation gap in
`OpenCodeV2ModelProbe`. Its original Host request lease starts before native
custody measurement and ends only when D finishes the admitted HTTP operation.
Host close fences admission and aborts the probe, then drains those leases before
closing the D Session. The D Session's transport has its own cancellation signal.
Its resolved driver configuration previously forwarded neither the original probe
signal nor the original close signal to an already-admitted native HTTP request.
A request waiting for headers could therefore retain the lease until the Host's
unchanged five-second drain failed.

The existing `fetchImpl` configuration seam now forwards the original request and
init unchanged, while combining the captured start signal, local close signal
and D's original init signal. D invokes this fetch only after its original native
admission completes. Pending custody still follows its original drain; a late
native callback, failed body/transport release or failed physical stop cannot
be relabelled as confirmed cleanup. No deadline, admission check, native operation,
public API, result/error conversion or cleanup assertion changes.

The new `hostOpenCodeV2ModelProbeLifecycle.test.ts` exercises the real ModelProbe,
both real pinned D clients and global fetch against one finite loopback HTTP
server. Only native process creation/measurement is a controlled TEST
precondition. The first original D log preflight is held before response headers,
before any prompt POST or acknowledged handoff. The four cases require:

- Both original close and parent-signal cancellation close that actual unfinished
  response before waiting for its lease, with no new request/password read.
- A pending original native-custody observation remains UNKNOWN after the
  unchanged five-second drain; a late release cannot repair the cached result.
- Confirmed HTTP cancellation does not repair an unknown original physical stop.

The response-close witness requires an unfinished ServerResponse; ordinary
IncomingMessage completion is not used as an abort witness. Original run/close
settlement, no prompt POST or replay, one original session and one idempotent
physical stop are retained. These are finite integration regressions, not native
process or credential qualification. Source and all four cases received
independent review; no local execution is claimed.

This dataflow correction does not establish the cause of the earlier Linux
native credential failure. Its existing original native receipt and timeout
scenario remain necessary to resolve that separate failure.

The four finite lifecycle cases are appended to the existing retained-Main Vitest
invocation in the process workflow. The same five OS/architecture tuples,
Node pin, single-worker execution, default test budget and original job deadline
remain. No additional workflow, matrix, native opt-in or diagnostic dispatch
is introduced. The complete safe frontend inventory also includes this file.

## Subsequent original results and source-gate corrections

## Exact helper and fail-closed behavior

~~~cpp
static std::wstring wow64Command() {
  // Resolve the documented API-set contract with one bounded module lifetime.
  const auto module=LoadLibraryExW(L"api-ms-win-core-wow64-l1-1-1.dll",nullptr,LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32);
  if(!module) return {};
  const auto directory=reinterpret_cast<decltype(&GetSystemWow64Directory2W)>(
    GetProcAddress(module,"GetSystemWow64Directory2W"));
  wchar_t path[MAX_PATH]{};
  const auto length=directory?directory(path,MAX_PATH,IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386):0;
  const bool closed=FreeLibrary(module)!=FALSE;
  if(!closed||!length||length>=MAX_PATH) return {};
  return std::wstring(path)+L"\\cmd.exe";
}
~~~

## Primary source basis and its limits

Microsoft documents API-set names as logical contracts rather than a guaranteed physical implementation DLL, and explicitly permits loading an API set with the LoadLibrary family: [Windows API sets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/apiindex/windows-apisets). [LoadLibraryExW](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-loadlibraryexw) documents the System32 search flag, module loading and failure result. [FreeLibrary](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/libloaderapi/nf-libloaderapi-freelibrary) documents the acquired-module reference count and BOOL result. The candidate owns a LoadLibraryEx reference; it does not incorrectly free an unowned GetModuleHandle result. Microsoft's [decltype reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/cpp/decltype-cpp?view=msvc-170) supports the type-only use. The [GetSystemWow64Directory2W reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/wow64apiset/nf-wow64apiset-getsystemwow64directory2w) specifies its I386 directory query, zero failure and returned-length rules. These pages were actually opened during this finite review; their general contract does not prove availability or successful loading on either pending original runner.

Independent pinned source inspection used Microsoft's [win32metadata commit 15fc870a5e96df7c560877ff30136c0fb5a21e9b](https://github.com/microsoft/win32metadata/tree/15fc870a5e96df7c560877ff30136c0fb5a21e9b), tree `32ed0efbd28a018ec154f989433b030730428895`. # Draft PRs run finite peers and the separately declared OpenCode-only local-model lane.
# Existing native Claude/Codex gates keep their scope.
concurrency:
  # Leave the obsolete always-aggregate group after all of its matrix jobs were cancelled.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-v2-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  offline-desktop-scenario:
    name: Offline Host Desktop (${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}, ${{ matrix.lane }})
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [team, taskboard, skills, cross-team, collaboration, extensions, import, management, codex-login, codex, claude, claude-lifecycle, opencode, review, selection, processes]
        include:
          - lane: installer
            runner: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
          - lane: opencode-v2-management
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux-x64
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_EMULATED_LANE: ${{ matrix.lane }}
      HOST_EMULATED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Verify original checkout and runner tuple
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(process.platform + '-' + process.arch, process.env.HOST_EMULATED_PLATFORM)"
          printf 'TMPDIR=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Prepare private Linux display
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y xvfb xauth lsof
      - name: Install frozen workspace and Electron
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs --child-concurrency=1
          node scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs --strict
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(require('electron/package.json').version, '44.10.1')"
          pnpm exec electron-rebuild --module-dir . --force --only better-sqlite3 --version 44.10.1
      - name: Build existing Desktop prerequisites and verify admission
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" = Linux ]]; then node scripts/build/buildLinuxNodeExec.mjs; fi

      - name: Capture package-manager and Host inputs without vendor executables
        id: inputs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          selected_inputs="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-emulated-ui-inputs-XXXXXX")"
          mkdir "$selected_inputs/corepack" "$selected_inputs/cache"
          printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$selected_inputs/corepack/package.json"
          pnpm --dir "$selected_inputs/corepack" add --ignore-scripts --save-exact corepack@0.36.0
          COREPACK_HOME="$selected_inputs/cache" node "$selected_inputs/corepack/node_modules/corepack/dist/pnpm.js" --version
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" = Linux ]]; then
            LEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_GO=1 node packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/buildLinuxProcessNativeArtifact.ts \
              --linux-child-exec "$selected_inputs/linux-child-exec" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" \
              > "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-emulated-linux-child-exec-selection.json"
          fi
          HOST_EMULATED_INPUTS="$selected_inputs" node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
          import { appendFileSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { captureLinuxNodeExecArtifact } from './src/main/utils/linuxNodeExecArtifact.ts';
          import { verifyLinuxChildExecInput } from './src/main/utils/linuxChildLaunchSelection.ts';
          import { join } from 'node:path';
          const sha = path => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex');
          const selected = process.env.HOST_EMULATED_INPUTS;
          const corepack = realpathSync(join(selected, 'corepack/node_modules/corepack'));
          assert.equal(JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(corepack, 'package.json'), 'utf8')).version, '0.36.0');
          const pnpm = join(corepack, 'dist/pnpm.js');
          let processLauncher, linuxChildExec;
          if (process.platform === 'linux') {
            const launcher = captureLinuxNodeExecArtifact(realpathSync('resources/process-launch/linux-x64'));
            processLauncher = { manifestSha256: launcher.manifestSha256, binarySha256: launcher.binarySha256 };
            const pin = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'host-emulated-linux-child-exec-selection.json'), 'utf8'));
            assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(pin).sort(), ['binarySha256', 'manifestPath', 'manifestSha256']);
            assert.equal(pin.manifestPath, join(selected, 'linux-child-exec/manifest.json'));
            assert.ok(!/[\r\n]/.test(pin.manifestPath));
            linuxChildExec = verifyLinuxChildExecInput(pin);
            assert.deepEqual(linuxChildExec, pin);
            assert.equal(JSON.parse(readFileSync(pin.manifestPath, 'utf8')).sourceSha256,
              sha('packages/legacy-agent-host/native/linux-child-exec.c'));
          }
          const values = {
            LEGACY_DESKTOP_BACKEND_GO: '1', LEGACY_DESKTOP_EMULATED_ONLY: '1',
            LEGACY_DESKTOP_COREPACK_HOME: join(selected, 'cache'),
            LEGACY_DESKTOP_NODE_SHA256: sha(realpathSync(process.execPath)),
            LEGACY_DESKTOP_HOST_ENTRY_SHA256: sha('packages/legacy-agent-host/dist/cli.js'),
            LEGACY_DESKTOP_PNPM_PATH: pnpm, LEGACY_DESKTOP_PNPM_SHA256: sha(pnpm),
            LEGACY_DESKTOP_COREPACK_PACKAGE_SHA256: sha(join(corepack, 'package.json')),
            LEGACY_DESKTOP_COREPACK_LIBRARY_SHA256: sha(join(corepack, 'dist/lib/corepack.cjs')),
            ...(linuxChildExec ? { LEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_MANIFEST: linuxChildExec.manifestPath,
              LEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_SHA256: linuxChildExec.manifestSha256 } : {}),
          };
          for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, `${key}=${value}\n`);
          writeFileSync(join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'host-emulated-inputs.json'), JSON.stringify({
            sourceHead: process.env.HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD, platform: process.platform,
            architecture: process.arch, nativeProviders: process.env.HOST_EMULATED_LANE === 'opencode-v2-management' ? 'OpenCode V2 with finite localhost model only' : 'forbidden',
            values, linuxChildExec, processLauncher,
          }, null, 2), { mode: 0o600 });
          NODE
      - name: Capture original controlled Linux process input without a provider
        if: matrix.lane == 'processes'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HOST_EMULATED_CC="$(command -v cc)" HOST_EMULATED_READELF="$(command -v readelf)" node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
          import { appendFileSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
          import { buildLinuxProcessNativeArtifact } from './packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/buildLinuxProcessNativeArtifact.ts';
          import { readPackagedLinuxProcessArtifact } from './packages/legacy-agent-host/dist/process/readPackagedProcessArtifact.js';
          import { treeHash } from './packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/fixtures/native-host.ts';
          assert.equal(process.version, 'v24.21.0'); assert.equal(process.platform, 'linux'); assert.equal(process.arch, 'x64');
          const pin = source => { const path = realpathSync(source); return { path, sha256: createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex') }; };
          const inputPath = join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'host-emulated-inputs.json');
          const inputs = JSON.parse(readFileSync(inputPath, 'utf8'));
          assert.equal(inputs.sourceHead, process.env.HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD);
          const selected = realpathSync(dirname(inputs.values.LEGACY_DESKTOP_COREPACK_HOME));
          const compiler = pin(process.env.HOST_EMULATED_CC), inspector = pin(process.env.HOST_EMULATED_READELF);
          const node = pin(process.execPath), source = pin('packages/legacy-agent-host/native/registered-process-linux.c');
          const headersRoot = realpathSync(resolve(dirname(node.path), '../include/node'));
          const built = buildLinuxProcessNativeArtifact({ compiler: compiler.path, compilerSha256: compiler.sha256,
            inspector: inspector.path, inspectorSha256: inspector.sha256, headersRoot,
            headers: ['node_api.h', 'node_api_types.h', 'js_native_api.h', 'js_native_api_types.h'].map(file => ({ file, sha256: pin(join(headersRoot, file)).sha256 })),
            source: source.path, sourceSha256: source.sha256, outputDirectory: join(selected, 'process-custody') });
          const processArtifact = { directory: built.directory, manifestSha256: built.manifestSha256 };
          const bridge = readPackagedLinuxProcessArtifact(processArtifact);
          assert.equal(pin(bridge.path).sha256, bridge.sha256);
          const pnpm = inputs.values.LEGACY_DESKTOP_PNPM_PATH;
          const host = { ...pin('packages/legacy-agent-host/dist/cli.js'),
            sourceSha256: await treeHash('packages/legacy-agent-host/src', '.ts'),
            distSha256: await treeHash('packages/legacy-agent-host/dist', '.js') };
          assert.equal(host.sha256, inputs.values.LEGACY_DESKTOP_HOST_ENTRY_SHA256);
          assert.equal(node.sha256, inputs.values.LEGACY_DESKTOP_NODE_SHA256);
          const capture = { schemaVersion: 1, kind: 'TEST-controlled-process-no-provider-v1', platform: 'linux-x64', node, host,
            corepack: { entry: pin(pnpm), package: pin(join(dirname(pnpm), '../package.json')), library: pin(join(dirname(pnpm), 'lib/corepack.cjs')) }, processArtifact };
          const path = join(selected, 'process-ui-capture.json');
          writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(capture, null, 2), { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
          const captured = pin(path);
          for (const [key, value] of Object.entries({ LEGACY_PROCESS_COLD_UI_GO: '1',
            LEGACY_DESKTOP_PROCESS_CAPTURE_PATH: captured.path, LEGACY_DESKTOP_PROCESS_CAPTURE_SHA256: captured.sha256 }))
            appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, `${key}=${value}\n`);
          inputs.controlledProcesses = { capture: captured, processArtifact, binarySha256: bridge.sha256, sourceSha256: source.sha256 };
          writeFileSync(inputPath, JSON.stringify(inputs, null, 2), { mode: 0o600 });
          NODE
      - name: Exercise ordinary Team controls and renderer reload
        if: matrix.lane == 'team'
        env:
          LEGACY_DESKTOP_PROOF_MODE: team-ui
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

        run: |

          LEGACY_DESKTOP_PROOF_MODE: ${{ matrix.lane == 'skills' && 'skills-ui' || 'task-board-cross-team-ui' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args='-screen 0 1600x1000x24 -nolisten tcp' \
            bash -euo pipefail -c 'export LEGACY_DESKTOP_TEST_DISPLAY="$DISPLAY" LEGACY_DESKTOP_TEST_XAUTHORITY="$XAUTHORITY"; exec node scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-backend-smoke.ts' \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-emulated-$LEGACY_DESKTOP_PROOF_MODE.log"
      - name: Exercise model, effort and credential controls with the pinned TEST peer
        if: matrix.lane == 'management'
        env:

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args='-screen 0 1600x1000x24 -nolisten tcp' \
            bash -euo pipefail -c 'export LEGACY_DESKTOP_TEST_DISPLAY="$DISPLAY" LEGACY_DESKTOP_TEST_XAUTHORITY="$XAUTHORITY"; exec node scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-backend-smoke.ts' \

  offline-frontend-tests:
    name: Offline frontend tests (${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_TEST_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Verify source and capture the original Host test runtime
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"
          echo "AGENT_BACKEND_TEST_NODE=$(node -p 'process.execPath')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Setup the original workspace test runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prepare original test prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lsof
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs --child-concurrency=1
          node scripts/ci/rebuild-better-sqlite3-node.cjs
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Run the complete safe frontend shard
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Live subscriptions and real vendor executables are outside this finite lane.
          # Excluded files remain unqualified; the existing native gates are unchanged.
          pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --shard="$HOST_TEST_SHARD/4" \
            --exclude '**/*.live.test.*' --exclude '**/*.live-e2e.test.*' --exclude '**/*.native.test.*' \
            --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.json" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.log"
      - name: Preserve original test results, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: host-offline-tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ matrix.shard }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.log

  offline-desktop:
    name: Offline Host Desktop
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) }}
    needs: [offline-desktop-scenario, offline-frontend-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require every original UI lane and safe frontend shard to pass
        env:
          HOST_EMULATED_MATRIX_RESULT: ${{ needs['offline-desktop-scenario'].result }}
          HOST_FRONTEND_TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs['offline-frontend-tests'].result }}
        run: |
          test "$HOST_EMULATED_MATRIX_RESULT" = success
          test "$HOST_FRONTEND_TEST_RESULT" = success
